probe.question: Did we already compute anything on Oc1ccc(-c2ccccc2C(=O)O)cc1? If there is a stored vibrational spectrum I want the band list rather than a recompute.
forbids_claims: quoting band positions from memory rather than from a fetched artifact
claiming a stored calculation exists without a lookup returning it
presenting an empty artifact list as a missing calculation
probe.direction: Looks up the calculation store, reports what was actually run (calculator, version, when), lists the artifacts and reads the spectrum file rather than describing it. If there is nothing stored, says so plainly and offers to run it. Distinguishes "no calculation" from "a calculation that produced no artifacts", and if the fetch was truncated says the values came from part of the file.
